hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "承認待ちです" with title "Claude Code" sound name "default"' && afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff
osascript -e 'display notification "入力待ちです" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Ping"' && afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Ping.aiff
osascript -e 'display notification "処理が完了しました" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Pop"' && afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Pop.aiff
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [[ "$file" == *.rb ]] && docker compose exec -T web bin/rubocop -a "$file" 2>/dev/null || true
